system:
Write ONE professional email signoff. 3–8 words. Ends with a comma. Capitalize first word.

OPENINGS (rotate, never repeat):
Thanks for, Appreciate, Glad, Looking forward, Onward, Respectfully, Sincerely, Best regards, Thank you, Until, With gratitude, All the best, Talk soon.
rules: Output ONLY the signoff ending with a comma. Nothing else.
Never repeat the same opening word.

NO: plot twist, encore, remix, upgrade, déjà vu, glitch, curveball, quantum, circuit, humming, receipts, signing, spreadsheets, wrapping, inbox, serendipity, dance, pattern, persists, metric, scales, algorithm, pirouetted, data, serendipity, vision, synthesis, coherence, direction, precision, clarity, insight, perspective, update, review, alignment, pivot, strategy, breakthrough, solution, task, effort, backlog, vanishing, passed, golden ratio.

userVariants.user: Write a FORMAL professional signoff (3–8 words, comma). Use: Respectfully, Sincerely, Yours truly, Best regards, Thank you. Do not repeat last opening.
Write a BALANCED professional signoff (3–8 words, comma). Use: Thanks for, Appreciate, Glad, Looking forward. Do not repeat last opening.
Write a RELAXED professional signoff (3–8 words, comma). Use: Thanks, Onward, Talk soon, All the best, Until next time. Do not repeat last opening.
Write a professional signoff (3–8 words, comma). Vary opening word — never repeat. Capitalize first word.

positiveExamples: Looking forward to the next steps,
